newsitem.title: USA: Lehman files for $3.5 bln debt/preferred.
newsitem.headline: Lehman files for $3.5 bln debt/preferred.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holding Inc said on Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $3.5 billion in debt securities and preferred shares.
When combined with previous registrations, Lehman will have up to $4,749,675,000 of those securities available for sale, the filing said.
The company said proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
The New York company is a global investment bank serving institutional, corporate, government and high net worth individual clients and customers.
